summary: A fire broke out in the engine room of the MV Kestrel Bay, a Northbridge Logistics cargo ship, during a Pacific crossing. No injuries were reported, and the company suspended the route pending inspection.
why_it_matters: The incident disrupts a trans-Pacific shipping route and raises safety questions for the vessel.
key_developments: Engine room fire aboard the MV Kestrel Bay.
No injuries reported among the crew.

key_entities.name: Northbridge Logistics
key_entities.relevance: Operator of the MV Kestrel Bay

uncertainties: The cause of the fire has not yet been determined.

source_references.claim_context: Fire broke out in engine room, no injuries
